messages:
Taylor: Opening PR to add a 'private installer: hardened networking & offline workflows' section — includes SELinux context note for PKCS#11 sockets, minimal nftables/iptables fallbacks, IPv6 opt-out, and offline repo mirror steps. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4721
Jae: Nice. Please add a short SELinux restorecon example and call out mounting /var/run with private tmp for the HSM process to avoid leaking sockets.
Roshni: Suggested wording for PKCS#11 perms: 'Ensure the PKCS#11 socket is owned by redwood:pkcs11 and has chmod 660. On SELinux-enabled hosts set the filecontext to pkcs11_socket_t and restorecon after package install.'
Roshni: SELinux/snippet to include:
```
chown redwood:pkcs11 /var/run/pkcs11.sock
chmod 660 /var/run/pkcs11.sock
semanage fcontext -a -t pkcs11_socket_t '/var/run/pkcs11.sock'
restorecon -v /var/run/pkcs11.sock
```
Miguel: For air-gapped mirrors add minimal apt/yum commands + gpg detach-sign checksum example and a tiny systemd timer for weekly mirror pulls. Something like:
```
# detach-sign checksum
gpg --output certs.tar.gz.sig --detach-sign certs.tar.gz
# systemd timer (sketch) - mirror.service + mirror.timer
```
Taylor: Also adding a short paragraph about HSM client backoff: exponential retry with jitter on PKCS#11 connection failures to avoid HSM overload during large-scale deploys.
DocsBot: docs-build-bot: preview built for PR #4721 — https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.internal/4721/ :white_check_mark:
Taylor: I'll add TOC anchors (Ports, Firewall examples, SELinux, Offline mirror) and fix any broken links in the installer checklist. Can folks review today? :eyes:
Jae: Ack, small wording tweak for backoff coming in a follow-up commit.
Roshni: Reviewing now, will comment inline on phrasing.
